description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

description:
About the job

Responsibilities

About the Team

The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated. We aim to bring discovery, inspiration, and joy back to shopping by making TikTok the commerce channel of choice for merchants, creators, and affiliates.

You've seen the virality and impact of #TikTokMadeMeBuyIt. Come join the team that is helping scale that phenomenon, and pioneer Content & Creator commerce in the LATAM. We aim to bring discovery, inspiration, and joy back to shopping by making TikTok the leading, on-trend commerce platform of choice for brands, creators, and shoppers. We are an entrepreneurial team, passionate about shaping the future of shopping.

The TikTok Shop LATAM operation team aims to deliver high quality products together with a unique customer experience via TikTok. The team is responsible for building the TikTok e-Commerce partnership for the TikTok e-commerce business in the US. With more than 1 billion loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better e-commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join us to build an e-Commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users together.

As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short-term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real-world experience. You will gain practical skills through on-the-job learning in a fast-paced work environment and develop a deeper understanding of your career interests.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.

Successful candidates must be able to commit to at least 6 months long internship period.

Responsibilities:

Seller Growth & Engagement


 Support the execution of seller growth programs such as webinars, educational sessions, and platform campaigns while assisting Category and Operations teams in promoting key initiatives including campaigns, LIVE activities, and promotional events.
 Help drive seller participation in platform programs, campaigns, and content initiatives and monitor seller feedback to help identify opportunities to improve engagement.


Content & Communication


 Support the creation and coordination of seller-facing communications across email, social channels, webinars, and community groups to help ensure communications are clear, accurate, and aligned with platform guidelines.
 Coordinate with internal teams to gather information and assets for seller communications, and assist in maintaining communication calendars and campaign materials organized and updated


Campaign & Project Management


 Support cross-functional seller marketing projects by coordinating with teams such as Content, LIVE, Product, Legal, and Operations.
 Track timelines, deliverables, and follow-ups to help ensure smooth execution and assist with campaign setup, reporting, and operational tasks.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications


 Applicants are kindly requested to submit an English-language resume
 Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Marketing or Communications
 Organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
 Strong communication and collaboration skills.
 Strong interest in e-commerce, creator economy, digital marketing, and marketplace platforms.
 Analytical mindset with basic knowledge of data analysis and reporting.


Preferred Qualification


 Previous internship or extracurricular experience in marketing, e-commerce, digital content, operations, or project coordination is a plus.


By submitting an application for this role, you accept and agree to our global applicant privacy policy, which may be accessed here: https://careers.tiktok.com/legal/privacy

Job Information

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

TikTok Accommodation

TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

About the job

Description

Amazon Mexico's Media Retail team is looking for a data driven, customer-obsessed, hands on and creative candidate to join our team. As a Brand Specialist, you'll own selected brands to help drive growth and help deliver a best-in-class customer experience on Amazon.com.mx, while facilitating great business relationships with some of Amazon's highest visibility brands.

Key job responsibilities

You'll be responsible for looking after the brands' product portfolio, contributing to improvements in the user experience for customers and creating detailed weekly reports on performance. You'll lead presentations and planning sessions with vendors and act as the main point of contact for them.

You will also provide support to drive business growth through detailed analysis of business inefficiencies and identifying solutions; proposing changes to operational processes; driving a high standard in customer satisfaction; ensuring high-quality product detail pages; and making recommendations for effective marketing campaigns.

To achieve success in this role, you will have strong analytical and relationship management skills. You are comfortable picking up new technologies and skills quickly. You'll be a problem solver, identifying issues or opportunity areas to then create plans to drive improvement.

As a Brand Specialist, You Will Be Fully Involved In All Business Functions Of Your Brands, Including Onsite Marketing, Vendor Relation Management And In-stock Management. Some Of The Tasks Associated With These Functions Include


 Online marketing: improving product page data, developing marketing and merchandising plans, improving customer experience onsite, helping generating traffic and sales
 Vendor management: help growing selection of products to sell on Amazon, onboarding new vendors, identifying and resolving pricing issues
 In-stock management: tracking purchase orders, investigating late deliveries, resolving order rejections, working with vendors on PO automation.


About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 1+ years of account management, project or program management or buying experience
 Bachelor's degree
 Experience using analytical specific tools such as Google Analytics, SQL or HTML
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience in process improvement
 Experience managing large amounts of data


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. About Equity Medical

Equity Medical is a rapidly growing clinical research organization dedicated to expanding access to clinical trials in underserved communities. We are seeking a bilingual Patient Recruiter & Retention Specialist to support participant recruitment and enrollment efforts across multiple clinical research sites.




Position Overview

The Patient Recruiter & Retention Specialist will be responsible for engaging prospective study participants, conducting pre-screening activities, supporting enrollment efforts, and maintaining ongoing communication to improve study participation and retention.

This is a remote independent contractor position supporting U.S.-based clinical research operations.




Key Responsibilities

Contact and pre-screen warm digital leads through the CRM to assess preliminary study eligibility.

Follow up consistently with prospective participants to reduce no-shows and increase enrollment conversion rates.

Schedule and coordinate participant appointments as needed.

Maintain accurate and timely documentation within the CRM and related systems.

Collaborate closely with marketing, recruitment, and clinical operations teams to achieve study enrollment goals.

Attend weekly meetings with on-site clinical teams.

Attend weekly meetings with the marketing and recruitment departments.

Conduct outreach to potential participants within the community in a professional, ethical, and compliant manner.

Communicate effectively with both English-speaking and Spanish-speaking participants.

Assist with retention initiatives to improve participant engagement and study completion.

Perform additional administrative and recruitment-related duties as assigned.




Qualifications

Fluent in both English and Spanish (written and verbal) – required.

Experience in patient recruitment, customer service, sales, call center operations, healthcare, clinical research, or a related field preferred.

Strong phone presence and interpersonal skills.

Comfortable making a high volume of outbound and follow-up calls.

Ability to build rapport and communicate effectively with diverse populations.

Strong organizational and time management skills.

Experience using CRM systems is preferred.

Clinical research experience is a plus but not required.

Schedule Requirements

Required schedule: Saturday through Wednesday.

Working hours: 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM Pacific Time (San Diego, California).

Must be available to attend scheduled team meetings and collaborate with U.S.-based teams during business hours.

Must maintain reliable internet connectivity and a professional remote work environment.

Preferred Experience

Clinical research recruitment.

Patient engagement and retention.

Healthcare scheduling or patient coordination.

CRM platforms and lead management.

Experience supporting U.S.-based organizations.




Independent Contractor Status

This position is offered as an independent contractor engagement. Contractors are responsible for their own taxes, insurance, equipment, and compliance with applicable laws in their country of residence.

Grace Ulerio -

Scheduling, Retention management, Documentation, Clinical research, CRM tools

About the job

Head de Promoción — Vertical Salud / Equipo Médico | Leasing y Crédito para Médicos

 

Sobre la empresa

Nuestro cliente es una SOFOM con 17 años de operación en el sector financiero mexicano, especializada en soluciones de crédito y arrendamiento (puro y financiero) para segmentos profesionales y empresariales. Cuenta con un equipo consolidado de más de 45 colaboradores, una cultura organizacional basada en integridad, cumplimiento y alto desempeño, y proyecta certificarse como Great Place to Work en 2027. Su estándar operativo es elevado, formal y orientado a resultados, con sólida disciplina regulatoria heredada de 7 años bajo supervisión CNBV.

 

Resumen de la oportunidad

Buscamos a un profesional comercial senior para construir y liderar la Vertical de Salud de una SOFOM con 17 años de operación (antes regulada CNBV). El objetivo: colocar crédito y arrendamiento (puro y financiero) a médicos especialistas, clínicas y distribuidores de equipo médico, a través de Vendor Programs con manufactureros y comercializadores.




No es un puesto heredado ni un arranque en frío: la empresa ya opera líneas preaprobadas para médicos —hasta $2.5 MDP en equipo médico y $1.5 MDP en autos— con documentación mínima. Tu foco es colocar, no pelear aprobaciones.

 

Este rol es para ti solo si cumples con los requisitos indispensables. Lee con atención antes de postular.

 

Responsabilidades principales

Prospectar, identificar y desarrollar Vendor Programs con manufactureros y comercializadores de equipo médico.
Prospectar directamente a médicos especialistas para AP-Leasing.
Diseñar y ejecutar programas vendor que aseguren colocación, trabajando en dos escalas: manufactureros y distribuidores, incluyendo planes de incentivos para distribuidores.
Ejecutar venta consultiva y venta de valor: identificación de stakeholders, calificación, manejo de tickets desde $500K hasta $3 MDP (foco principal: ultrasonidos $800K–$1.5 MDP).
Negociar y cerrar operaciones rentables dentro de los parámetros financieros establecidos (tasas, comisiones e incentivos).
Brindar servicio postventa para sostener una relación contractual promedio de ~39 meses.
Coordinar cotización, integración y armado de expedientes con apoyo de Mid/Back Office.
Coordinar análisis de crédito y aclaración de dudas con áreas internas.
Realizar primer contacto de cobranza en caso de retraso (modelo principal: débito directo).
Visitar Vendors y clientes para mantenimiento de relación.
Elaborar reportes de promoción y pipeline semanal.
Participar en el reclutamiento progresivo de su equipo comercial.




Alcance del cargo

Cobertura inicial: Zona Metropolitana del Valle de México (CDMX + Estado de México).
Expansión gradual a Querétaro, Hidalgo, Puebla, Morelos y Tlaxcala.
Estructura proyectada: de 1 a 4 Ejecutivos de Promoción y Servicio/Relación a construir progresivamente (sin equipo inicial; estructura se forma a partir del mes 3).

title: Digital Growth Specialist
description:
About the job

El propósito central del puesto es liderar y unificar la identidad de marca de la empresa en canales digitales y físicos, asegurando consistencia visual, narrativa y comercial. Además, debe articular la comunicación a lo largo del embudo de marketing -atracción, consideración, conversión y retención- para maximizar el retorno de inversión publicitaria, reducir costos de adquisición y fortalecer la retención de clientes.

Responsabilidades principales

· Gestionar agencias externas: supervisar la agencia creativa en conceptos, master graphics y parrillas de contenido; coordinar a la agencia de performance para alinear piezas pagadas con segmentaciones tácticas y optimizar CAC, CPA y ROAS.

· Custodiar la identidad de marca: garantizar el cumplimiento del Brand Book en redes sociales, sitio web, e-commerce y email marketing, además de coordinar su actualización junto con diseño gráfico.

· Coordinar contenido audiovisual: planear, guionar, grabar y editar videos para TikTok, Reels y YouTube Shorts, cuidando que cada pieza refuerce el mensaje central de marca: "Refacciones sin Vueltas".




Estrategia de journeys y embudo

Manejo de tres journeys según el nivel de relación con la marca. 

Para nuevos clientes, la prioridad es adquirir mediante anuncios segmentados, landing pages con disponibilidad inmediata, incentivos de primera compra y encuestas postentrega. 

Para clientes con una o dos compras, el enfoque se desplaza a retención temprana mediante retargeting, onboarding por email, carritos abandonados vía email/WhatsApp y campañas de cross-sell o up-sell. 

Para clientes recurrentes, quienes concentran una parte crítica de los ingresos, la estrategia se basa en comunicación directa, alertas de stock, CRM, checkout express, líneas de crédito, programas VIP y logística prioritaria.




Segmentos clave y enfoque de comunicación

· Flotilleros: buscan reducir tiempos muertos y mejorar rentabilidad; requieren mensajes de eficiencia operativa, inventario en tiempo real, facturación consolidada y suministro programado.

· Revendedores: necesitan margen y rotación; se atienden con promociones por volumen, catálogos interactivos, lanzamientos anticipados y pre-órdenes.

· Hombre-camión: enfrenta desconfianza en pagos digitales, fraudes y costos de envío; requiere transparencia, seguridad, pagos flexibles, testimoniales y evidencia visual de originalidad.

· Refaccionarias y talleres: necesitan identificar piezas exactas y agilizar devoluciones; se proponen guías técnicas, infografías, tutoriales y herramientas de autogestión.

About the job

Who We Are

Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.

We’d Love To Hear From You If

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

As a Paid Search Senior Specialist, you will plan, build, and optimize Paid Search and Shopping programs that drive efficient client growth. You’ll execute high-quality campaign management, translate performance data into clear actions, and apply automation and Bliss Point insights to reduce waste and improve outcomes. You’ll set and deliver Rocks with directional KPIs, collaborate across Analytics, Creative, Product/Bliss Point, and Client Leadership, and mentor junior teammates. We align scope and expectations to our job architecture for consistency and transparent progression.

Key Responsibilities

Client‑Centric


Support the building and executing of Paid Search/Shopping campaigns aligned to client objectives, audience, inventory, and ecommerce or lead gen realities; surface trade‑offs and options.
Communicate performance and recommendations clearly to internal partners and clients; contribute to QBRs with actionable next steps.


Product‑Led


Use platform capabilities (Google/Microsoft Ads, SA360/Skai), feed tools, and responsible automation (e.g., value‑based bidding, Performance Max) to improve efficiency and outcomes.
Apply Bliss Point insights (e.g., Always‑On Incrementality, Forecasting, Creative Insights) to inform optimizations; flag data quality issues and provide structured feedback to product teams.


Data & Measurement‑Driven


Monitor performance daily/weekly; analyze trends; design basic A/B tests with success criteria; forecast expected impact where feasible.
Maintain data integrity (tagging, feeds, tracking); partner with Analytics to validate reads and address anomalies.


The Tinuiti Way


Demonstrate deep Paid Search/Shopping craft with growing awareness of adjacent channels; connect measurement to growth; document playbooks and “how‑to” guides for repeatability.


Owner Mindset


Take initiative to eliminate spend and process waste; prioritize work against Rocks; follow through to impact and share learnings.


Ways of working and values


Greatness attracts Greatness: Seek feedback, hone craft, embrace new tools and AI.
Clients grow, we grow: Lead with precision, innovation, and proof.
Culture of ownership: Act with speed, reduce waste, and own outcomes end‑to‑end.


Professional & Technical Qualifications


Experience: 4–5 years executing Paid Search/Shopping with end‑to‑end ownership of builds, launches, pacing, and optimization; monthly budgets $75K+.
Platform fluency: Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Merchant Center; SA360 or Skai; competitive tools (Auction Insights, Adalysis/Adthena/SpyFu).
Analytics: GA/GA4, advanced Excel/Sheets; ability to build clear performance narratives and basic forecasts; design/run A/B tests.
Communication and collaboration: Clear client‑facing updates; cross‑functional teamwork; ability to mentor and delegate work to more junior team members.
Certifications: Google Search & Shopping (or completed in the first 60 days). Additional Google certifications are a plus.


KPIs 


Efficient growth: Improve efficiency KPIs while contributing to revenue targets.
Waste reduction: Decrease non‑converting spend; improve feed/tagging fidelity; reduce rework.
Product/AI usage: Pilot and adopt relevant platform/Bliss Point features with documented impact.


We operate on a flexible hybrid model, but we love seeing our team! For this role, we ask that you come into our great office in Reforma, CDMX, two days a week. This is an essential part of how we collaborate and connect, so candidates should be comfortable with this regular in-office commitment.

Please contact us to request accommodation.

Benefits

Unlimited PTO: At Tinuiti, we believe you deserve time to rest, recharge, and enjoy life unplugged. When you prioritize time for yourself, you're able to bring your best self to work. That’s why we offer unlimited paid time off, a hybrid work environment, and flexibility to take the time you need, when you need it. On top of that, we provide 16 paid holidays, including multiple long weekends, to ensure you have dedicated time to step away and disconnect. We're proud to offer above-industry standard work-life balance, consistently rated as one of the most loved benefits by Tinuitians year after year.

description:
About the job

🚀 ¿Por qué trabajar en Xepelin?
Xepelin está transformando las finanzas empresariales en Latinoamérica con una suite de productos que automatizan la gestión financiera y facilitan el acceso a liquidez. Con el objetivo de convertirse en el CFO digital de todo negocio, ha desarrollado tecnología financiera que impacta en todo el ecosistema empresarial. Gracias a la data obtenida por la interacción de +1M de empresas dentro de su network, se construye un sistema de inteligencia de negocios que da visibilidad de indicadores financieros y evaluaciones de riesgo de la red con la que se colabora, ayudando a que la toma de decisiones sea más rápida y segura.

Nuestros principios ¿Cómo operamos?
🎯 Ponemos a nuestros clientes en el centro

✨ Creemos e inspiramos

🧑‍💼 Actuamos como dueños

🏅 Lideramos con el ejemplo

🏆 Nos desafiamos para ganar

🧠 Tomamos riesgos con inteligencia

🤖 Usamos el poder de la tecnología

¿Qué estamos buscando?
En Xepelin estamos buscando personas creativas y visionarias que piensen fuera de la caja para sumarse a nuestro equipo. Si te apasiona resolver desafíos interesantes de alto impacto y quieres ser parte de un entorno dinámico que está transformando la industria financiera, ¡Esta oportunidad es para ti!

Si te motiva el desafío de construir soluciones innovadoras en un entorno de rápido cambio, queremos conocerte.

Únete a nosotros, ¡crezcamos juntos!

Misión del rol
Ser el cerebro analítico detrás de la estrategia de crecimiento de Xepelin México: definir dónde, cómo y a qué costo adquirimos clientes — y convertir ese análisis en decisiones que el negocio ejecuta. El problema central es de los buenos: ¿dónde está el siguiente peso de crecimiento rentable? ¿Más Outbound, mejor pricing, otro segmento, un canal nuevo? Es un problema de asignación de capital, y tú eres quien lo modela, lo recomienda y lo acompaña hasta el resultado.

Principales responsabilidades


Estrategia de crecimiento y asignación de recursos: definir, junto al liderazgo del negocio, la estrategia de adquisición de la compañía — qué canales (Outbound, Inbound, Brokers, Digital), qué segmentos (SMB/Mid/Corp) y qué economics justifican cada inversión
Owner analítico del funnel completo: NQL→SQL→Enrolamiento→Aprobación→Activación→Retención. Diagnosticar dónde se pierde valor, cuantificar el tamaño de cada oportunidad y mantener un Control Tower con CAC, payback, LTV y Gross Profit por canal, levantando alertas cuando algo se desvía de la tesis
Resolución de problemas estratégicos (tu día a día estilo consultoría): estructurar problemas ambiguos en análisis accionables — descomponer una caída de ventas en tasa × ticket × volumen, diagnosticar un funnel SDR, dimensionar un canal nuevo con un business case
Pricing & elegibilidad (con Riesgo): modelar bandas de precio/score-cut y diseñar/leer experimentos A/B que equilibren aprobación y margen
Research de cliente: entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done e insights de mercado que se traducen en ofertas, mensajes y apuestas de segmento
De la recomendación a la ejecución: bajar la estrategia a instrumentos operables — playbooks de Outbound, lead scoring, territories, listas activables (AI/enrichment), briefs de Digital — y coordinar handoffs con SDR/AE, Marketing y Growth
Cadencia operativa: preparar y facilitar WBR/MBR. No reportas métricas: cuentas la historia del negocio, propones la decisión y das seguimiento a los compromisos
Experimentación y gobierno de datos: priorizar hipótesis, diseñar tests, instrumentar tracking, productizar ganadores (playbook + métricas); definir eventos, taxonomías y QA de tracking con Analytics/Eng





¿Qué necesitas para brillar?


Pensamiento estructurado: descompones problemas ambiguos en árboles de hipótesis, priorizas el análisis que mueve la decisión y comunicas con claridad ejecutiva (escrita y verbal)
Estratega operador(a): la recomendación no te basta; bajas la idea a dashboard, playbook y piloto en días, no semanas
Data chops: SQL intermedio-avanzado, manejo de BigQuery/Looker o equivalentes; familiaridad con causalidad/experimentos y métricas de funnel
AI driven: experto en Claude/Chat GPT/Gemini/otros, con casos de uso claros y con impacto
Track record de impacto en KPIs: has movido números concretos — enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn — y puedes contar el cómo, no solo el cuánto
Obsesión por el cliente: research continuo, entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done, y capacidad de transformar insights en ofertas y mensajes accionables
Influencia cross-functional: te mueves con Revenue, Growth, Riesgo, Producto y Finanzas con la misma comodidad, sin autoridad formal
Owner mindset: foco en impacto económico (CAC, payback, margen, LTV), no en entregables





Requisitos


2+ años en consultoría estratégica o roles GTM/Strategy/Growth/RevOps analíticos, ideal con foco en adquisición B2B (fintech, SaaS, pagos o lending es plus)
Experiencia probada gestionando funnel completo y mejorando KPIs (enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn)
SQL (intermedio a avanzado) y Excel/Sheets avanzado





Nuestros Beneficios:

🌴 Xepelin Balance

Vacaciones: 15 días hábiles. Por cada año que cumplas en Xepelin, te damos un día extra de vacaciones.

Balance days: 10 días libres adicionales al año, para disfrutar como quieras.

Beneficios Flexibles: Puntos flexibles en tu moneda local al mes para gastar en lo que quieras.

🚀 Xepelin Performance & Career

Plataformas de capacitación: Convenios con las mejores plataformas, como Udemy y Google Cloud Skill Boost.

Kit de Bienvenida: todo lo que necesitas para comenzar tu viaje en Xepelin 😊

🤝 Xepelin Cares

Cobertura de salud: contamos con convenios de salud con proveedores de calidad o reembolsos según el país donde te encuentres.

Post Natal: te damos una semana extra de licencia post natal. ¡Nos interesa que estés con tu familia y seres queridos!

Matrimonio plus: Lleva tus planes al siguiente nivel, con una gift card y extendiendo tu permiso legal por matrimonio con dos días de regalo por Xepelin.

About the job

Languages: English, Portuguese, Spanish

Department: AdTech

About The Role

Cybba is looking for a senior strategist to own media planning and strategy for the Brazil and Mexico markets and run it to US standards. This is a hands-on, end-to-end role: you take a client objective and carry it the full distance, from channel strategy and programmatic and social activation through attribution design, execution oversight, and the measured outcome.

You own the margin on what you build, you turn what works into repeatable managed offerings, and you keep a hard record of which proposals win and which lose so the next strategy is sharper than the last. You serve as the bridge between Cybba’s US capability and the LATAM market, fluent enough in both to present at a high level on either side.

Responsibilities

Media Strategy & Planning


Build end-to-end media plans across programmatic, paid social, and emerging channels for Brazil and Mexico, aligned to US planning standards. 
Translate client objectives into channel strategy, budget allocation, flighting, and measurement design. 
Own attribution planning, including foot traffic and closed-loop retail measurement where it applies (Gretel, Measurement Suite, Audience Intelligence). 
Stay current on each market’s media landscape, supply availability, and regulatory constraints (LGPD in Brazil, LFPDPPP in Mexico). 


Platform & Solution Depth


Plan and operate across DSPs: The Trade Desk, DV360, StackAdapt and MediaSmart 
Know the supply side: SSP landscape, inventory quality, and DOOH and CTV supply paths into each market. 
Run paid social strategy across Meta, TikTok, and the platforms that matter regionally. 
Use measurement and analytics platforms to set KPIs up front and prove outcomes at the end. 
Working knowledge of identity and audience solutions (LiveRamp and similar). 


Profitability & Productization


Own campaign and managed-service margin. Scope, price, and structure work to hit profitability targets, not just spend targets. 
Turn repeatable strategies into productized managed-service offerings the team can deliver efficiently and at scale. 
Document playbooks so delivery does not depend on a single person’s memory. 


Win/Loss Tracking & Feedback Loop


Track every proposal: won, lost, the reason, the competitor where known, and the economics. 
Run a structured feedback loop that pushes those outcomes back into the next round of strategy, pricing, and packaging. 
Identify the patterns behind wins and codify them. Discard what consistently loses. 


Client & Stakeholder Engagement


Present strategies, plans, and results to clients and internal leadership. The standard is senior, confident, and clear in all three languages. 
Partner closely with the US product, data engineering, and commercial teams so LATAM strategy and US capability stay in sync. 


Required Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field. 
6+ years in media planning and strategy with real programmatic depth. 
Hands-on DSP experience. You have built and optimized live programmatic campaigns, not just briefed them. 
Tri-lingual at professional working proficiency: English, Portuguese, and Spanish. All three are non-negotiable. 
Strong presentation and storytelling skills. You can hold a room and a screen share. 
Demonstrated ownership of strategy end to end, including the commercial outcome. 
Strong collaborator who works well across functions and time zones. 


Preferred Qualifications


Direct experience in the Brazil and Mexico media markets. 
Retail media and attribution background. 
Experience productizing managed services or solutions, not just running campaigns. 
Familiarity with agile or scrum delivery and the Atlassian stack (Jira, Confluence). 


Attributes & Professional Growth


Strong interest in operations best practices and bringing structure and rigor to planning, pricing, and delivery workflows. 
Strong appetite for continuous learning and platform certifications. Relevant credentials expected, or obtainable within the first 90 days: 
The Trade Desk Edge Academy 
Meta Blueprint 
Google (GA4 and Google Ads) 
DV360 or equivalent DSP certification 


6-Month Success Criteria


A documented, repeatable planning and pricing approach live for both markets. 
Managed-service margin at or above target on owned accounts. 
A live win/loss record with a feedback loop that has measurably improved win rate or proposal quality. 
At least one productized offering shipped and delivered at scale.

About the job

The Role

The D2C Customer Experience Leader is responsible for defining and elevating the end‑to‑end Direct‑to‑Consumer (D2C) experience across digital, physical, and assisted channels for Mexico and LATAM. This role drives the execution of the D2C roadmap while championing customer‑centric transformation, design thinking, and best‑in‑class omnichannel experiences aligned with corporate data privacy principles.

Acting as the strategic voice of the customer, this position ensures alignment between business objectives and customer needs to accelerate growth, reduce friction, and differentiate the brand.

What You’ll Do

D2C Experience Strategy


Execute the long‑term D2C customer journey vision across all touchpoints, leveraging Voice of Customer (VOC).
Lead the full lifecycle experience: discovery, compatibility tools, purchase, checkout, order tracking, installation, warranties, and post‑sale.
Define experience principles, frameworks, and design standards.


Roadmap Ownership


Define and execute CX initiatives, enhancements, and capabilities based on customer and business priorities.
Partner with Product, IT, UX, and business teams to ensure alignment with customer experience standards.
Provide clear direction on what and why for experience requirements.


Customer Engagement, Conversion & Innovation


Design initiatives to improve acquisition, engagement, loyalty, and conversion.
Lead ideation of new digital solutions and omnichannel capabilities.
Identify emerging trends, technologies, and opportunities for new revenue streams.


Insights, VOC & Performance Improvement


Analyze VOC metrics (NPS, CSAT, CES) and behavioral data to guide decisions.
Define KPIs and monitor journey performance to identify improvement opportunities.
Translate insights into strategic recommendations and executive reporting.


Activation, Adoption & Change Management


Drive internal enablement strategies: training, communication, and CX guidelines.
Track adoption using qualitative and quantitative metrics.
Champion customer‑centric transformation and D2C maturity across the organization.


What Success Looks Like


Seamless, intuitive, and scalable omnichannel customer journeys.
Measurable improvements in CX KPIs (NPS, conversion, engagement).
Strong adoption of D2C tools and processes across the organization.
Clear alignment between customer insights and business strategy.
Continuous innovation in customer experience and digital capabilities.


What You Bring


Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or related field (Master’s preferred).
5+ years in Customer Experience or Service Design, with at least 3 years in digital/technology‑driven initiatives (omnichannel, O2O, CX transformation).
Proven experience designing customer journeys and leading CX strategies.
Experience developing roadmaps and business cases.
Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
Fluency in English and Spanish.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
Experience with tools such as Miro, Figma, Qualtrics, GA4, Hotjar, and CRM systems (preferred).

Soft Skills


Strategic and systemic thinker.
Strong influence and collaboration skills across senior stakeholders.
Customer‑centric mindset with creativity and curiosity.
Structured, results‑oriented, and highly accountable.


About Clarios

Clarios is the global leader in advanced, low-voltage battery technologies for mobility. Our batteries and smart solutions power nearly every type of vehicle and are found in 1 of 3 cars on the road today. skills: Respond to optimization, risk analysis, attribution, and risk modeling questions from clients.

description:
About the job

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

Why this role is important to us

SimCorp leverages the most sophisticated risk analytics and portfolio-construction tools on the market, with a globally diverse client base that challenges us to continue innovating.

SimCorp is currently seeking a qualified professional to join our Global Support team as a full-time employee. The position will be based in our Mexico City office. Candidates should have a minimum of a Master's in Finance, Quantitative Finance, Financial Engineering, Economics, or 1-2 years of relevant work experience with a related undergraduate degree. Beyond the opportunity to work directly with clients, team members will gain invaluable industry experience while working in a challenging, yet fun work environment.

Responsibilities


Respond to optimization, risk analysis, attribution, and risk modeling questions from clients.
Provide structured and custom training for new and existing clients.
Assist clients in translating their portfolio construction strategies into Axioma products, while providing helpful insights into Axioma’s innovative methods. Assist Sales Team members in creating proof-of-concept analysis via portfolio analysis and product demonstrations.
Provide specialized guidance during evaluations of SimCorp's software products including initial training, day-to-day usage questions, and by supporting the Sales and Product Specialists teams during client trials.
Assist sales organization as necessary to facilitate effective client retention and new business development.
Collaborate with senior Global Support staff and other SimCorp resources in responding to advanced client inquiries.


Qualifications


Proficient written and oral communication skills.
Minimum of a Master's in Finance, Quantitative Finance, Financial Engineering, Economics, or 1-2 years relevant work experience with a related undergraduate degree.
Knowledge with or experience with multi asset class securities (equity, fixed income, FX, and derivatives).
Solid educational foundation in math and statistics, familiar with linear and non-linear methods of interpretation in market theory and quantitative disciplines of risk analytics / portfolio construction.
Proficient computer skills and experience with coding languages (R, Python preferred, Java).
Skilled at problem solving and quickly identifying problem resolution for clients.
Commitment to assisting and teaching clients how to benefit from SimCorp products.


Benefits

Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work and life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid workplace model. On top of that, we have IP sprints where you have 3 weeks per quarter you can spend on enhancing your skills as well as contributing to the company development. There is never just only one route - we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

NEXT STEPS 

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds in general.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients, with SimCorp as the overarching company brand and Axioma as a key product brand.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated in our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

While seeking to deliver client value, we believe it is vital to consider our people and our planet in every business decision we make. Acting responsibly is not optional. It is essential.

About the job

At Edstruments, our customers are called partners, so internally you will hear this role referred to as Partner Support Specialist (or PSS). Same role, different vocabulary. We default to “partner” language throughout our team, our tools, and our documentation, and your day-to-day will use that language too.




About Edstruments

Edstruments empowers K12 and nonprofit leaders with modern financial software spanning the Procure-to-Pay lifecycle and Budget Planning & Management. Our platform helps our partners align their spending and budgets to strategic objectives so that they can best achieve their mission. As a fast-growing startup, we add several new partners each month, and our platform is currently in use by organizations across multiple states in the US. We are seeking individuals who are excited to play a critical role in helping our partners achieve their missions.




Role Overview

The Customer Support Specialist will be the first line of defense on chat and email, helping our partners resolve technical and administrative issues, ensuring smooth communication, and troubleshooting challenges. You will manage incoming chats and emails, track tickets, and ensure partner needs are met efficiently. The role also involves vendor outreach, administrative tasks, and product setup for new clients. 2+ years of experience in technical support, software support, or a related role.

Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present technical information clearly to non-technical users.
Strong attention to detail and excellent time management skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience in customer support for SaaS platforms or other software solutions.

Background in the education or nonprofit sectors is a plus.

This is a 100% remote role with a flexible start date, but availability during US Pacific Time business hours (8 am - 5 pm) is required.

Edstruments does not and will not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender orientation, gender expression, age, national origin, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status in any of its hiring decisions or other activities.

Why Edstruments?

description:
About the job

Teamwork makes the stream work.

 

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

 

 About the team

The International Ad Marketing team helps drive Roku's advertising business across international markets by developing the strategies, stories, and programs that position Roku as a leader in the streaming ecosystem. In Mexico, that means localizing Roku's advertising proposition into locally relevant marketing that drives results with advertisers, agencies, and strategic partners.

We work closely with Ad Sales, Brand Marketing, Research, Product Marketing, Communications, Creative, and external partners to build strong go-to-market plans, market-facing narratives, and partner programs that support visibility, engagement, and revenue growth.

About the role

Roku is seeking an Ad Sales Marketing Manager, Mexico to help accelerate our advertising business in Mexico and Spanish-speaking Latin America. This role operates at the intersection of sales marketing, partner marketing, and go-to-market execution, with a strong emphasis on helping Roku and its strategic partners bring compelling stories and solutions to market. You will own partner marketing strategy and execution across key strategic partners in Mexico, developing sales enablement materials, partner-facing narratives, co-marketing programs, and activation plans that support business growth. This is a strategic, highly cross-functional individual contributor role designed for someone who understands how to localize market insight, commercial priorities, and partner collaboration into marketing that drives visibility, engagement, and revenue. You will collaborate daily with teams across Ad Sales, Brand Marketing, Research, Product Marketing, Communications, Creative, and external partners to build strong go-to-market plans and market-facing narratives. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment and brings a hands-on approach to both strategic thinking and tactical execution.

What you'll be doing
Develop sales enablement and partner-facing materials that help internal teams and external partners bring Roku stories and solutions to market
Create presentations, one-pagers, narratives, and proof points tailored for advertisers, agencies, and strategic partners in Mexico
Localize research, market trends, and business opportunities into partner-ready narratives, programs, and activation ideas
Equip the sales team with compelling, locally relevant materials that support client engagement and business growth
Partner closely with Ad Sales, Ad Marketing, Research, Product Marketing, Data, Creative, and Communications teams to ensure alignment between business priorities and local execution
Build clear working models and repeatable frameworks for partner collaboration, including planning processes, messaging, creative development, and measurement
Ensure partner programs are on-brand, commercially relevant, and executed with excellence
Own partner marketing strategy and execution across key strategic partners in Mexico
Develop and execute partner marketing plans that strengthen Roku's market presence and support business priorities
Manage day-to-day partner collaboration, ensuring plans, deliverables, timelines, and communications stay aligned and on track
Identify and lead co-marketing opportunities with strategic partners, including campaigns, events, content, and activation programs that expand Roku's reach and support revenue goals
Support the Brand Marketing lead with co-marketing programs and co-events to drive partner visibility, engagement, and revenue
We're excited if you have
5+ years of experience in B2B marketing, sales marketing, partner marketing, or commercial marketing, ideally in media, advertising, ad tech, streaming, or technology
Strong experience in the Mexico advertising market, with a clear understanding of the local advertising, agency, media, and partner ecosystem
Direct experience working with strategic partners, alliances, co-marketing programs, or sales enablement initiatives
Strong storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to localize data, research, and market dynamics into clear commercial narratives
Experience developing go-to-market programs and marketing materials that support both brand visibility and revenue outcomes
Strong project management and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
A collaborative, hands-on mindset with willingness to operate strategically while also driving execution
Fluency in Spanish and English
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth, and evolving environment
 

 

Our Hybrid Work Approach

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are flexible for remote work except for employees whose roles are required to be in the office five days a week or employees who are in offices with a five day in office policy.

 

Benefits

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

 

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

 

The Roku Culture

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. 

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

title: Content & Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
About the job

Saya Biologics is a Pan-American, agile, and digitally native biopharmaceutical company working to make the global pharmaceutical standard accessible in Mexico, Latin America, and soon, the United States. In 2025, Saya ranked #1 in biologics submissions to COFEPRIS (the Mexican Federal Commission for Protection against Sanitary Risks) and among the top 10 in generics and biosimilars.




Objectives

Design websites, execute campaigns, and propose ideas for Saya Biologics' image and digital presence, ensuring visual and editorial consistency across external channels.

Create and manage content for social media (primarily LinkedIn) and other digital channels that reinforce Saya's positioning as an agile, digitally native biopharmaceutical company focused on accessibility.

Use of tools such as Claude Design, WhatsApp for Business, Notion, Gemini, or other similar platforms.

Operate an editorial calendar with a marketing focus (audiences, messaging, formats, timing, owners, and approvals) to communicate launches, partnerships, and corporate milestones.

Coordinate with Marketing, Business Development, Regulatory Affairs, and Medical Affairs to ensure scientific accuracy, compliance, and strategic alignment. Use artificial intelligence tools safely and effectively to maximize productivity and content quality, always respecting company standards.




Activities




Brand & Creative Direction

Design, execute, and propose strategic plans to position Saya's image on digital channels: look and feel, templates, recurring formats, and visual guidelines applied to posts and materials.




Content Strategy & Production

Design and publish content for social media (primarily LinkedIn) that communicates company milestones, product launches, and strategic alliances.




Digital Marketing & Distribution

Manage the editorial calendar: define objectives per piece/campaign, messages, formats, timing, owners, approval workflow, and publication.




PR & Media (Support)

Coordinate, along with the external PR agency, support for media opportunities when applicable: materials, message alignment, and internal validations.




Internal Coordination

Work closely with the Marketing Manager to align content with marketing strategy and launches.




Use of AI and Digital Tools

Leverage AI tools (Notion AI, internal agents, content generation tools) to accelerate drafting, trend analysis, and content optimization.




AI Red Lines: Do not use AI for medical/regulatory content without review; do not publish AI-generated content without human editing; do not share confidential information with external tools.




Monitoring and Analysis

Track mentions of Saya in media and social networks.

Identify trends and opportunities in the biopharmaceutical ecosystem in Mexico and Latin America.




Agency Management

Develop strategic briefs aligned with the launch roadmap and corporate priorities.




Education




Required:

University degree in Communication, Journalism, Public Relations, Marketing, or a related field.




Desired:

Demonstrable experience or interest in the healthcare, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology sector.

Familiarity with design tools (Canva, Figma, Adobe Suite). 




Experience

Minimum:

1-2 years of experience in digital content creation, social media management, or public relations.

Portfolio demonstrating the ability to create engaging and professional content.




Desired:

Previous experience in the healthcare, pharmaceutical, or B2B sectors.

Experience working with AI tools for content creation.

Experience in media, journalism, or press relations.




Professional Skills

Advanced English (reading and writing; many reference materials are in English)

Excellent Spanish writing skills (clarity, conciseness, and appropriate tone)

Proficiency in professional social media (especially LinkedIn)

Knowledge of basic design tools

Ability to translate technical concepts into accessible language

Proactive and safe use of AI tools ( Claude, Notion, etc.)

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.

The Role

Joining the Performance Department (performance marketing) as our Project Lead, you'll be responsible for providing stability within your team by supporting your direct manager through mentoring, training, and developing team members. You will also apply expert-level strategic thinking to promote sustainable project growth, ensuring long-term success in performance marketing initiatives.

Your focus of responsibilities will be:


Domain: Making expert-level project contributions, autonomously leading projects of varying complexity to a high standard of quality, with a focus on testing and creative problem solving, maintaining client success where applicable and reasonable while supporting others around you and teaching others to do the same.
Client: Exemplifying Thrive's standards for client success through strong day-to-day communication, agile and proactive problem solving, project management, and anticipating client needs.
People: Accountable for training and developing team members to be world-class performance marketers with Thrive's standards of quality and impact to aid in the growth of company performance expertise.
Company: Understands and takes action to be a key influencer and innovator in helping Thrive improve our products and services, and enhancing team member contributions while aligning individual contributions with the wider team or program objectives.


We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:


In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s mission, values, and processes, complete your technical onboarding bootcamp, and onboard onto your team, emphasizing on building relationships.
In your first 60 days you’ll put your learning, skills, and experiences into action by supporting on assigned client accounts, preparing and leading client calls, and helping your Strategist manage projects end-to-end.
In your first 90 days you’ll have become integrated into the team, becoming an efficient contributor and trusted partner to your assigned clients and team members. You’re starting to train others on the work we do. 


Qualifications


You have executed, maintained, and scaled performance marketing accounts of $100k-200k USD media spend per month at a consistently positive ROI for the client across multiple platforms at a time including Meta, Google Ads, YouTube, Display, Programmatic Platforms, TikTok, Twitter, Spotify and others.
You have experience directly collaborating with and supporting team members to achieve project & team goals. You have coached, mentored, or trained people before, helping them reach their career development goals.
You have advanced analytical skills and experience using data visualization tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Google Data Studio, Tableau or similar platforms to pull, sort, analyze and draw insight from ad platforms, analytics, and / or business intelligence tools. You have built your own dashboards before, or automated some manual reporting to make it more efficient. 
You’ve managed performance media across a range of business verticals and sizes (ecommerce, lead gen, etc), and have been responsible for leading projects end-to-end, including delegation to more junior team members.
You have successfully managed and grown client relationships via weekly touchpoint meetings and asynchronous communication, and were able to make strategic recommendations that helped grow their business in the form of quarterly planning meetings or similar.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

title: SDR (Inbound & Outbound)
description:
About the job

Acerca de Nosotros:

TheGurúCompany: Somos un Venture Builder con 23 años de experiencia, especializados en desarrollar, invertir y co-crear empresas B2B de nicho. Utilizamos tecnologías avanzadas como Inteligencia Artificial y Visión por Computadora para impulsar el crecimiento de nuestros proyectos y de nuestros clientes a nivel global.

Acerca de este Rol

Como SDR (Inbound & Outbound) en TheGurúCompany, tu misión será generar y gestionar oportunidades de negocio de alto valor, combinando estrategias de prospección outbound con la atención y calificación efectiva de leads inbound.

Este rol es clave para asegurar un flujo constante y saludable de pipeline. Serás responsable tanto de iniciar conversaciones estratégicas con prospectos como de capitalizar el interés generado por marketing, asegurando velocidad, calidad y conversión en cada interacción.

Buscamos a alguien que no solo ejecute, sino que piense en cómo hacer más eficiente todo el proceso: desde el primer contacto hasta la generación de oportunidades calificadas, utilizando datos, creatividad y tecnología (incluida IA).

Responsabilidades:

Gestión de Leads Inbound

 Dar seguimiento oportuno a leads entrantes provenientes de campañas, formularios, eventos y otros canales.

 Calificar prospectos con base en fit, necesidad y timing.

 Contactar rápidamente para maximizar tasas de conversión.

 Agendar reuniones de calidad para el equipo de ventas.

Prospección Outbound

 Generar nuevas oportunidades mediante outreach multicanal (email, LinkedIn, llamadas, networking).

 Identificar cuentas objetivo y construir listas de prospectos de alto valor.

 Diseñar y ejecutar secuencias de contacto personalizadas.

Investigación y Personalización

 Investigar empresas, industrias y perfiles clave para adaptar mensajes relevantes.

 Detectar pains, oportunidades y triggers comerciales.

 Utilizar herramientas de data e IA para enriquecer la prospección.

Optimización y Performance

 Medir desempeño de campañas y esfuerzos (open rate, reply rate, conversión a reunión).

 Optimizar continuamente mensajes, canales y enfoques.

 Probar nuevas herramientas, automatizaciones y estrategias.

Colaboración con Marketing y Ventas

 Trabajar de la mano con marketing para mejorar la calidad de los leads inbound.

 Alinear esfuerzos con ventas para asegurar reuniones calificadas.

 Retroalimentar con insights del mercado y comportamiento de prospectos.

Gestión de CRM y Pipeline

 Registrar y actualizar interacciones en el CRM.

 Mantener orden y visibilidad del pipeline generado.

 Asegurar handoff claro y documentado al equipo de ventas.

Acerca de Ti:

Formación y Experiencia:

 Mínimo 2 años de experiencia como SDR o en ventas B2B.

 Experiencia tanto en manejo de leads inbound como en prospección outbound.

 Deseable experiencia en tecnología, SaaS o soluciones digitales.

Conocimientos Técnicos:

 Manejo de CRM (Odoo, Salesforce, HubSpot o similares).

 Experiencia con herramientas de prospección (Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc.).

 Familiaridad con herramientas de automatización (Outreach, Lemlist, Instantly).

 Conocimiento o interés en herramientas de IA (Clay, Claude u otras).

 Nivel de inglés intermedio (deseable).

Habilidades Clave:

Velocidad y sentido de urgencia: respondes rápido y priorizas correctamente leads inbound.

 Mentalidad data-driven: tomas decisiones basadas en métricas y resultados.

 Comunicación efectiva: redactas y comunicas con claridad y persuasión.

 Autonomía: gestionas tu pipeline con responsabilidad y enfoque en resultados.

 Curiosidad y mejora continua: optimizas constantemente tus procesos.

 Organización: manejas múltiples leads y campañas sin perder calidad.

Stack (ideal, no excluyente):

CRM: Odoo

 Prospección: Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay, Lusha

 Automatización: Outreach, Lemlist, Instantly

 IA & Data: Clay, Claude y herramientas similares

KPIs del Rol:

Reuniones agendadas (SQLs) y calificadas

 Tiempo de respuesta a leads inbound

 Tasa de conversión (lead → reunión)

 Tasa de respuesta outbound

 Pipeline generado

 Volumen de actividades (emails, llamadas, LinkedIn)

Lo que ofrecemos:

Trabajo 100% remoto

 Cultura enfocada en resultados, autonomía y aprendizaje constante

 Exposición a herramientas y estrategias de inbound y outbound moderno + IA

 Oportunidad de crecimiento dentro del equipo comercial

About the job

Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

You will help create and execute the growth strategy for McKinsey clients' digital sales.

In this role, you will build top-performing B2B and B2C paid media programs across multiple social advertising platforms as well as owned channels. You will be responsible for helping our marketing teams through the generation of significant insights. You will conduct data analysis, generate insights, and verify them with appropriate organizations within marketing, and you will share your recommendations with key business decision-makers.

You will tell stories with the data and enable growth marketing to make strategic decisions based on growth potential. You’ll work with data scientists and engineers, analysts and researchers to compile recommendations, develop capabilities and define requirements for projects that will help activate our strategic insights with the business. You will work with partners across digital marketing to improve the performance of clients' websites and digital marketing campaigns.

You will be based in our Mexico City office as part of McKinsey Digital. McKinsey Digital brings together the best of McKinsey’s digital capabilities to help our clients use digital technology to transform their businesses.

As part of this group, you’ll join a global team working on everything from IT modernization and strategy to agile, cloud, cybersecurity and digital transformation. You’ll typically work on projects across all industries and functions and will be fully integrated with the rest of our global firm. You’ll also work with colleagues from across McKinsey & Company to help our clients deliver breakthrough products, experiences, and businesses, both on technology and non-technology topics.

Our office culture is casual, fun and social with an emphasis on education and innovation. We have the freedom to try new ideas, experiment and are expected to be constantly learning and growing. There is also a strong emphasis on mentoring others in the group, enabling them to grow and learn.

description:

1. Build and own the partner pipeline, sourcing indie animation studios, IP holders, and institutional partners across AIGC and emerging formats & grow them into long term relationships
